name: Farmington Hills (United States)
description: Dark green field charged with a white panel bearing the city logo, FARMINGTON HILLS Michigan in green over a stylised hill.
history: Farmington Hills is a city in Oakland County, Michigan. Flags of the World records that this flag with the city's newer logo, seen on the city's Facebook page from 2010 and at the 2013 Michigan Municipal League conference, replaced an earlier flag carrying the city seal.
